verdict.rationale: Wise's docs show card-issuing and spend-control APIs (create cards, set MCC/currency-based rules, control spending permissions) which could support purpose-scoped virtual cards, but the evidence frames these as partner/platform APIs for issuing cards to 'your customers' rather than a finance-lead self-service flow inside the Wise Business dashboard for vendor- or ad-spend-scoped cards. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an in-app/dashboard 'create virtual card' flow for Wise Business users, confirmation that a finance-lead (not a platform partner) can instantly generate a card, and any single-vendor/purpose-scoping UI or case study.
